posts.caption:
I switched off my kick's pitch envelope. It got 16 dB more sub.

DS Kick in Ableton, three layers, Env normally at 68.2 %. After 50 ms the kick is still at 90 Hz. With Env at 0 it's at 45 Hz at the same moment.

Measured on the kick bus: same loudness (-12.2 vs -12.1 LUFS), but +16 dB below 60 Hz and -4 dB from 60 to 120 Hz. It also rings: 155 ms to fall 40 dB instead of 85.

Decay is the other knob. At 27.6 % the kick never falls below -19 dB before the next hit. At my 4.5 % it drops to -83 dB between kicks. That gap is the room for the bass.

Uhrwerk aus Blut is out now. Part 11 next: the bass groove.
This lead is built like a broken radio. 24 Serum 2 presets from my studio: leads, plucks, FX, brass, pads. Link in bio.
